title: Length bound for the split word
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $c$ and a finite Boolean word $y$, the length of the split word of $y$ is at most $2|y|+2$.
replaced:
For every word $y$, the emitted split word for $y$ has length at most
$2|y| + 2$, including on malformed (unsplittable) inputs.
